verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents paying W-2 employees by direct deposit, with same-day or next-day options and auto payroll (docs-5, docs-6, docs-9). On the contractor side it documents 1099-NEC/MISC creation, e-filing, and sending copies to contractors in the same platform (docs-7), but the evidence never says it actually pays contractors. missing for 10: explicit documentation of contractor payments (e.g., direct deposit to 1099 workers), confirmation that W-2 and 1099 payments run together in one workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
